summary_en: IHI raised its fiscal 2027 year-end dividend forecast by 2 yen to 13.5 yen per share, bringing full-year dividend to 25 yen, reflecting stronger earnings guidance with operating profit revised up 8.0% to 270 billion yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Year-end Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
IHI Corporation announced a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company raised its year-end dividend per share from the previously forecasted 11.5 yen to 13.5 yen, representing a 2 yen increase. Combined with the interim dividend of 11.5 yen paid in the first half, the full-year dividend per share is now expected to reach 25 yen, compared to the prior forecast of 23 yen.

The increase is based on the company's upwardly revised earnings guidance announced on the same day. Operating profit is now projected at 270 billion yen, up 8.0% from the previous estimate of 250 billion yen. Net income attributable to parent shareholders is forecasted at 185 billion yen, a 7.6% increase, with basic earnings per share rising to 173.88 yen from 161.67 yen.

This dividend hike aligns with IHI's "Medium-to-Long-Term Direction" published in May 2026. During Phase 1 (fiscal 2026-2028), the company prioritizes investment in growth areas while maintaining a stable dividend policy with the objective of achieving sustained per-share dividend increases. The dividend is subject to approval at the 210th Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for late June 2027.
